liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Peter** (1 review): Reviewer describes Black Peter as a nice performance during the show [7]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer characterizes the Saint Stephen performance as good [7]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-12.sbd.serafin.88908.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 11 songs; 56 min; rated 3.4/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1970-02-12.sbd.sssb.murphy.5932.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 11 songs; 56 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the crowd at the end of Casey Jones sounds very large, like a Fillmore audience; Reviewer describes the recording quality as crystal clear, rating it five stars based on audio alone [5][8]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the tape contains five songs, though they believe it is the 2/13/70 early show [3]
- Reviewer states the tape is simply the early show from 2/13/70 [10]
- Reviewer claims no known setlist exists for 2-12, suggesting no tape exists for that date [11]
- Venue held approximately 500 people, with most seats removed to allow additional standing room only concertgoers [2]
- Reviewer finds the performance as inspired as the 2-13-70 shows, with Bobby performing exceptionally well [4]
- Reviewer calls this a nice precursor to the epic show that happened a couple nights later [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-12.sbd.serafin.88908.shnf**: transferred by Jay Serafin; source: SBD > 8 TRACK 1" RTR @ 7.5 I.P.S. > MASTER ARCHIVE 24-BIT D > SSSB [1]
- **gd1970-02-12.sbd.sssb.murphy.5932.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Any/all editing, fades, NR, hiss elimination, phase shifting/"time smear" correction, jitter elimination, and +/-2 dB max. EQ were performed using 100% digital-only processing (24-bit/96 kHz data stream) at Serafin Station Studio B; transferred by EAC (High, Secure) > WAV > SHNv3 by Patrick Murphy; source: SBD > 2-track RTR @ 15 i.p.s. > PCM > ? > D > SSSB [2]
